name: January
objective: Turn New Year intent into paid commitments that are active on 1 Feb; re-up the annuals due Dec–Feb; test the 3-for-2 newcomer pack.
strategy:
Resolutions with Receipts.

Commercial job: Turn New Year intent into paid commitments that are active on 1 Feb; re-up the annuals due Dec–Feb; test the 3-for-2 newcomer pack.

Spot: The 57-Hour Hangover Sale (“Hungover? Same. 1 month unlimited, flat ₹15,000. 57 hours only.”). January is the strongest non-April month in Mumbai (Jan-26: Kwality ₹27.4L, Bandra ₹20.0L; Kenkere ₹11.1L). A capped spot price creates urgency without training clients to wait — only 57 units per city, so the maximum discount exposure is ~₹3.0L in Mumbai and ~₹2.6L in Bengaluru.

Newcomer: Third Time's the Charm (“First class: awkward. Second: better. Third: hooked. 3 classes for the price of 2.”). 60.6% of first-timers never take a 2nd class. Purchase within 60 days by month-1 visits: 0 return visits 10.8%, 1 → 43.9%, 2 → 73.3%, 3–4 → 88.6%. The 2-for-1 route converts 20.8% (Bandra 17%). A third class moves people into the 73–89% band.

Renewal: The Baker's Dozen (“12 months is so 2026. Renew your annual and get 13.”). Annual is Kwality's #1 product (32 units, ₹51.6L in the last 12 months) and Bandra's #3 (15 units, ₹23.8L). The ANN-2026-25%-KH code gave away ₹9.7L at a flat 25%; this gives less cash away (≈21.5% effective) and adds time, which costs little at spare capacity.

Lapsed: U Up? It's 2027. (“U up? Your mat's been asking about you.”). Bandra is reactivation-led (3,209 lapsed vs 5,065 renewed membership records). Renewal climbs with usage: Bandra members using <50% of sessions renew 49–58% vs 82% at 75%+. The bonus is only paid for attendance that predicts the next renewal.
notes: Build: 71 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹7.9L; 78 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹18.1L; 35 winbacks = ₹4.0L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.0L. Offers carry ₹23.4L (71% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 51% CRM status, trial→member 26.9%) — not invented lifts.

funnel.dataQuality: lead→trial = CRM 'Trial Completed' status (not attendance-verified); trial→member = trailing measured; see dataGaps
